days.title: ハザン – クアンバ – イエンミン
days.morning: Rent a motorbike or hire an easy rider, check in at the Km0 marker.
days.afternoon: Quan Ba Heaven's Gate, the Fairy Twin Mountains and Yen Minh pine forest.
days.evening: Stay in Yen Minh, try thắng cố or black chicken hotpot.

days.title: ドンヴァン – ルンクー
days.morning: The Vuong family mansion and Tham Ma slope.
days.afternoon: Climb Lung Cu flag tower – Vietnam's northernmost point.
days.evening: Wander Dong Van old quarter and its cafés.

days.title: マーピーレン – ニョークエ川
days.morning: Cross Ma Pi Leng pass and admire Tu San canyon.
days.afternoon: Take a boat on the Nho Que river, then head to Meo Vac.
days.evening: Join the love market (if in season) and stay in Meo Vac.

days.title: メオヴァック – ズーザー
days.morning: Ride the Meo Vac – Du Gia route over majestic slopes.
days.afternoon: Swim in Du Gia stream, lunch at a homestay.
days.evening: Stay in Du Gia with a Tay family around the campfire.

days.title: ホアンスーフィー
days.morning: Continue to Hoang Su Phi and its nationally listed rice terraces.
days.afternoon: Visit Nam Hong village and ancient shan tuyết tea hills.
days.evening: Back in Ha Giang city for egg rice rolls.
